summary: Replaced the global settings with an immutable Settings plus make(), and passed conf explicitly through every function that needs it, using the entry-point signatures from the guide. Removed import-time and stale caches (units, dim divisor, closed days, freight minimum, fuel factor, FX factors, zone table, quote cache keyed by settings), updated the tests, and checked that CLI output matches the original on about 400 setting and command combinations.
